item.title: Trump tariff reversal could cut costs for US energy firms but will likely leave broader flows unchanged
item.description: The court's ruling could reduce the cost of building LNG plants and other large-scale energy infrastructure that rely on modules and other parts manufactured in foreign countries hit by tariffs.

item.title: Southern Co raises spending plan by 7% as data center power demand swells
item.description: U.S. utilities have invested heavily to upgrade electric grids as they face extreme weather and growing demand from power-hungry data centers dedicated to AI and cryptocurrency.

item.title: Global pipe fabrication leader and master distributor, Epic Piping, LLC, expands capacity to stay ahead of growing demands
item.description: Epic Piping, LLC (EPIC) has invested $25 million to expand and upgrade its advanced pipe fabrication operations in Livingston, Louisiana.

item.title: Infinity Natural Resources completes transformational $1.2 billion acquisition of Ohio Utica assets
item.description: The addition of these assets to Infinity’s portfolio significantly enhances the company’s position in the core Ohio Utica Shale.

item.title: Sweethearts and Shotguns
item.description: BIC Alliance captures highlights from the Texas Chemistry Alliance Sweethearts and Shotguns Shooting Clinic and Clay Shoot at Bevly Farms in Corpus Christi, where industry leaders gathered for networking, competition and camaraderie.

item.title: Amazon selects Louisiana for $12 billion data center campuses in major U.S. expansion
item.description: The project is expected to create 540 direct new jobs and Louisiana Economic Development estimates the project will result in 1,700 additional indirect new job opportunities in the Northwest Region.

item.title: Xcel Energy to power new Google data center in Minnesota
item.description: As part of the agreement, Xcel and Google are partnering to bring 1,900 megawatts of new clean energy to the grid.

item.title: Houston-based company signs 20-year agreement with world's largest oil company
item.description: Caturus will sell 1 million tonnes per year of LNG from Commonwealth LNG’s site in Cameron Parish, Louisiana, to Aramco Trading Americas LLC, a subsidiary of Saudi Aramco, for 20 years.

item.title: How targeted training is working to help improve workplace safety
item.description: As industry continues to grow, programs like the Safety Academy aim to ensure that growth does not come at the cost of human life, turning hard lessons from past tragedies into safer futures for the workforce.
